# Oracle: plain go help stays byte-identical to upstream (version differs).
[!exec:/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/Cellar/go/1.27.3/libexec/bin/go] stop 'upstream go 1.27.3 not installed'
go help
cp stdout $WORK/our-top.txt

-- check_version.sh --
#!/bin/sh
set -e
want="$("$GOROOT/bin/go" env GOOS)/$("$GOROOT/bin/go" env GOARCH)"
grep -q "${want}$" "$WORK/version.txt"
